b: I was going to skip writing about this place.. But I'm writing it so the story doesn't lose its thread..

Mithra was adamant that we had to go early in the morning.. The ticket comes to ten lakhs.. We bought it online.. Even if you buy it there it's the same price… but you don't have to stand in the queue.. We left by car first thing in the morning.

Ba Na Hills is a mountaintop near that city… but you don't have to climb at all.. Seems they've leased it to a company.. The people from a company called Sun World take you up by cable car..When we got to the foot of the mountain it was a huge place like a Japanese or Korean palace …Since it was a Monday there were fewer people…They gave us a big map to look around with.. Taking it all, we got on the cable car..

Going in a cable car for the first time.. One glass box for the five of us.. It goes up the mountain for twenty, twenty-five minutes.. You can see everything nicely on the way.. If it were here, they'd make me climb the mountain till I was out of breath.. And when I'd dragged myself up and thought I'd sit down for a bit, they'd say it's late, let's go, and take me down…If they brought this system here it'd be easy for people like me.

The first thing we saw at the top was a bridge called the Golden Bridge. A bridge like a piece of string held up by two hands made of rock.. That's what lots of people come to see… You have to come early.. Otherwise the whole bridge is full of people.. A good place for photos.. Lots of girls had come in pretty dresses.. Because of the clouds you couldn't see anything below.. Otherwise it would have been even more beautiful..

While we were taking photos, people kept walking back and forth across.. Despite all that we somehow took our photos and went on.. "The art of love can't be learned by being told.." In the same way, I can't describe what's beyond.. You only know if you go and see.. Places so beautiful you get your fill and say enough, enough.. All of it man-made… At one point we stopped taking photos.. The beauty your eyes see doesn't come through the camera.. That beautiful..

If you're people who haven't been to Europe or Japan, come here once.. You can see buildings from every country here.. Then you won't need to go out for five or six years.. They're still building lots more …We even teased them that there were no temples or tanks.. Next time you'll see, there'll be those too.( If possible it'd be nice to build a branch temple for IBC Pillaiyar)

Then you can play some games there.. Everything we played on as kids at Sathutu Uyana is there .. And it's included in the ticket price.. We're people who use everything that's given free.. And we'd paid as well.. We got on and off everything… There's one called the Alpine Coaster… like a roller coaster.. For that you have to pay 70000 extra… but it's great.. We went on that twice too.. They scared me saying I'd fall off.. In the end it was him who held the brake and went slowly.. I went at full speed without fear..

The food there is a bit of a problem. I get it, you're saying for you food's a problem wherever you go.. But since it's a mountaintop everything's double price.. So if you go, take packed food: your gain.. their loss..
(There we bought something like a cake for a dollar and ate it.. It was good.. If you want it, buy it there.. but I think you can get it in other places too)

We watched films in lots of theatres one after another, 3D, 4D.. We watched a French dance.. Greek statues.. British buildings.. a Japanese temple.. You could go on listing… But the big problem is that the cable car doesn't run after six… Yet even close to six, people strolled around at leisure.. I don't know if there's any other way out.. But I scolded and chased these ones and somehow got them on the car before it closed.. Otherwise they'd happily have slept up there and come down the next day
When we got to the room we went to bed terribly tired.. Tomorrow we'll see the beauty of Da Nang
note: "The art of love can't be learned by being told" is a line from Subramania Bharathi. Sathutu Uyana is a children's park in Colombo.
